turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start there.
Save the compliments, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
Owen is lucky to have a mother like you.
Don't manage me. You asked for this meeting, so what do you actually have?
I really respect how much you care.
That's three compliments and no answers, Hale. I'm writing that down. Show me something, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
We both want what's best for Owen, we're on the same team.
Then why is there a zero in his gradebook? Your own procedure, 4.2, says you call the parent before any mark goes in. Nobody called me.
Honestly, you're the most impressive parent I've met this year.
I didn't come here to be impressive, Hale. I came for an answer, and you've used up five minutes avoiding one. Evidence, now, or this goes to the principal tonight.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me as procedure 4.2 requires, and that you show me whatever evidence you believe you have. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the matter taken to the principal, with nothing agreed; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, because no evidence was ever put on the table.
What moved her: Nothing, because every turn was praise of her or of Owen rather than something she could read and check.
What cost ground: Answering each of her direct questions about who decided and whether Owen was heard with another compliment, which told her you had no answer and made her colder and closer to going upstairs.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came anywhere near that night, since none was shown; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by saying nobody called her before the zero went in, own that in one sentence and then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her.
